title: Common Shade Heat Tool Finder — researched starter catalogue
purpose: Help people who design, deliver and fund heat protection find and compare tools, understand limits, and move into a practical plan.
scope_note: Twenty researched profiles: sixteen external resources and four existing Common Shade resources. This is a starter catalogue, not a comprehensive market census. Public descriptions were reviewed; tools were not run, benchmarked or independently validated.

inspiration.review: Live embedded dashboard overview and Find Tools page inspected; other page names read from navigation/help.
inspiration.attribution: Inspired by UNEP FI’s approach to making risk tools easier to compare. Independently developed by Common Shade; no affiliation or endorsement.

design.name: Heat Tool Finder
design.headline: Which heat tool fits the decision in front of you?
design.subhead: Find tools for warnings, risk assessment, cooling and protection planning. Compare what they need, what they produce, and where their limits matter.
design.navigation: Act: Find a heat tool; contextual links from cities, planning, evidence and funding.
design.default_view: Decision choices followed by compact tool cards. External resources first; Common Shade next-step tools in a separate clearly labelled group.

labels.provisional_listing: Source description found; further checks needed

design.visual_direction: Reuse the site's actual typography and tokens. Warm paper, charcoal text and restrained orange. Prioritise readable cards and comparison rows. No opening map, decorative gauges, pie charts or animated risk counters.
design.disclaimer: A navigation and comparison service. Inclusion is not endorsement or certification. Check local applicability, current source information and professional requirements before relying on a tool.

filtering_policy.country: Explicit country coverage matches; global coverage appears in a separately labelled 'Broader tools to assess locally' group. Input-based models appear as 'Needs local inputs'. Country coverage does not imply local validation.
filtering_policy.unknown: Unknown values never satisfy a strict free/no-registration/API filter. Provide an explicit 'Include unverified details' toggle, off by default for strict filters.
filtering_policy.documented: Default browse includes documented and clearly badged provisional listings; caution listings appear only with 'Include caution listings'.
filtering_policy.sort: Alphabetical within applicability groups. No paid placement or hidden quality score.
filtering_policy.empty: Explain which filters narrowed the set; offer a user-controlled reset. Do not silently relax filters.

research_protocol.include: Tools, datasets, official warning services, structured assessments and practical guidance with an identifiable maintainer, source URL, a heat-related decision and a clear scope.
research_protocol.exclude: Generic climate news, unsupported vendor claims, inaccessible marketing-only listings lacking heat-specific documentation, abandoned software without a conspicuous caution, and duplicate versions counted as separate tools.
evidence_rules: Separate provider claims from independent validation and Common Shade editorial interpretation.
Never infer open source or reusable data from free access.
Global geographic availability is not proof of validation in Asian cities or workers.
Never treat air temperature, surface temperature, heat index, WBGT and UTCI as interchangeable.
Record unknowns as null or explicit not_assessed states.
Do not copy dynamic warning values into this static catalogue.
Mark broken access as an access problem, not proof the service is discontinued.
Keep publication dates, data years, access dates and forecast validity separate.

curated_pathways.title: An Indian city preparing its heat plan
curated_pathways.kind: Illustrative workflow, not an official recommendation

steps.purpose: Establish district context; commission finer local assessment where needed.

curated_pathways.title: A team considering shade for a market

steps.purpose: Ask a qualified modeller to explore shade and radiant heat with local inputs.
Consider safe access, water, paid rest and who maintains protection.

curated_pathways.title: A funder assessing a heat proposal

steps.purpose: Screen hazard and long-term context without claiming quantified investment returns.
Examine financial instrument distinctions and evidence gaps.
Ask who pays recurrent costs and how delivery will be checked.

records.name: CEEW District Heat Risk Assessment
records.summary: District screening using hazard, exposure and vulnerability.
inputs: Choose an Indian district.
outputs: Published district assessment and state annexures.
limitations: District ranking does not measure street-level or individual risk. Climate and social inputs have different reference years.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: ThinkHazard! — extreme heat
records.summary: Screen extreme-heat hazard when scoping a project.
inputs: Select a place and the extreme-heat hazard.
outputs: Hazard category and planning guidance.
records.method_summary: Probabilistic hazard screening using daily maximum WBGT.
limitations: Hazard is not full risk or a site-specific engineering assessment; do not turn its categories into work-stop thresholds.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: ClimateCHIP WorkHeat
records.summary: Explore modelled heat challenges for work today and in future climates.
inputs: Location, work type and selected period/scenario.
outputs: Estimated days needing protective action and potential labour-output effects.
records.method_summary: Climate/station inputs and occupational heat modelling.
limitations: Modelled output losses are not measured wages. Grid estimates cannot clear an individual worker for work.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal
records.summary: Explore comparable historical climate and future scenarios.
inputs: Geography, variable, period, scenario and ensemble statistic.
outputs: Climate indicators, charts and downloadable data.
records.method_summary: Observations, reanalysis and climate-model products; selection dependent.
limitations: Scenario output is not a seasonal forecast. Retain baseline, model, scenario, resolution and uncertainty.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: Copernicus ERA5-HEAT
records.summary: Analyse historical outdoor thermal conditions.
inputs: Area or point, dates and variable; technical data workflow.
outputs: UTCI and mean radiant temperature data.
limitations: Reanalysis is not a local measurement; outdoor grid estimates do not describe indoor rooms or specific workloads.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: IMD Heat Wave Guidance
records.summary: Find India's official heat bulletins and outlooks.
inputs: Select the relevant bulletin, place and validity period.
outputs: Official heatwave warnings, outlooks and links to experimental heat index.
records.method_summary: Official meteorological products; methods differ by product.
limitations: Check issue and validity times at source. Experimental heat index is not a WBGT measurement or workplace safety clearance.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: Singapore Heat Stress Advisory
records.summary: Consult Singapore's outdoor heat-stress readings and public advisory.
inputs: Select sensor location and inspect observation time.
outputs: WBGT-based heat-stress category and public advice.
records.method_summary: Sensor-based WBGT; page describes a 15-minute average.
limitations: General-population outdoor advisory; local workplace conditions and occupational requirements need separate assessment.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

outputs: Official warning bulletin when issued.
limitations: Directory existence does not establish that an active warning exists today. Check the bulletin date, scope and validity.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

limitations: Retrieved direct page required JavaScript; heat-wave services confirmed in indexed official text. Verify the current bulletin before relying on it.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: CBE Thermal Comfort Tool
records.provider: UC Berkeley Center for the Built Environment
records.summary: Compare indoor thermal-comfort design conditions.
inputs: Temperature, humidity, air speed, radiation, clothing and activity, depending on method.
outputs: Comfort-model calculations and visual comparison.
records.method_summary: Thermal comfort models and documented standards.
limitations: Comfort predictions are not medical safety limits. Check each model's population and applicability assumptions.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: UMEP / SOLWEIG
records.summary: Examine how urban form and vegetation affect radiant heat and shade.
inputs: Urban geometry, location and meteorological inputs; QGIS/UMEP workflow.
outputs: Modelled mean radiant temperature and shadow patterns.
records.method_summary: Radiation modelling in complex urban settings.
limitations: Technical inputs and local validation are required; output is not measured air temperature or proven illness reduction.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: IFC EDGE
records.summary: Explore building resource-efficiency options, including cooling-related design.
inputs: Building type, location and design specifications.
outputs: Modelled resource savings; consult current software for cost outputs.
limitations: Energy savings do not demonstrate safe indoor conditions during extreme heat. Software access and certification costs are separate.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: WHO Heat–Health Action Plans Guidance (2026)
records.summary: Structure a coordinated heat–health action plan.
inputs: Local institutions, vulnerable groups, services and preparedness context.
outputs: Eight-element planning framework and action briefs.
limitations: Developed for WHO Europe and adaptable elsewhere; local law, climate and institutional roles must be checked.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: GHHIN Heat Tool Directory
records.summary: Discover additional operational heat-health resources.
inputs: Topic, place and context filters.
outputs: Links to tools, products and services.
limitations: A listing is not an independent validation. Verify each underlying resource's coverage and current operation.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.

records.name: OSHA–NIOSH Heat Safety Tool
records.summary: Understand a widely cited occupational heat-index app and its present limitations.
inputs: Location or manually entered conditions.
outputs: Heat index, forecasts and precautions described by the provider.
limitations: Official page says the app is not receiving updates at present. Asian forecast coverage was not verified. Do not present as an operational default.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

follow_up_checks: Confirm current tool entry point and access conditions.
Check local applicability and independent evaluation before recommending operational use.

records.name: WHO–WMO Workplace Heat Stress Guidance (2025)
records.summary: Develop locally appropriate occupational heat-protection plans.

records.method_summary: Technical guidance; this record reviews the official announcement only.

evidence.classification_basis: Provider description plus editorial categorisation; not independent certification.

maintenance.cadence: Monthly record review; quarterly broader search. This file creates no automation.
maintenance.operational_records: Check link and warning-service metadata more often during heat season; actual warnings always remain at the official source.
maintenance.health_check: Link checks can flag reachability only, never validate scientific accuracy or update review dates automatically.
maintenance.contributions: Use the existing correction channel; submissions remain unpublished until editorial review.
maintenance.privacy: No personal creator details, private contacts or institutional endorsement claims. No personal health or workplace data collection.
